source.scope: All abstract and main-text claim-bearing prose and Tables 1--5 (PDF pp. 1--9), plus the draft's required completion tables, Tables 17--18 (PDF pp. 24--25). References, appendices, style-generated anonymous text, and author-attestation fields are not treated as scientific claims.

decision_vocabulary.supported_now: May be stated only at the recorded provenance/inspection level; it is not a live result.
decision_vocabulary.conditional_design: Retain only as an intended mechanism, conditional invariant, or evaluation protocol; do not word as deployed or effective.
decision_vocabulary.preliminary_report: Retain only with its checked-in provenance and limitations; it is not a rerun or a positive efficacy result.
decision_vocabulary.evidence_required: Cannot appear as a positive manuscript claim until the named evidence is frozen and independently checked.
decision_vocabulary.narrow_or_remove: Remove the positive/deployment assertion unless the named qualification is completed; retain a limitation or future-work statement instead.
decision_vocabulary.author_attestation_required: Do not infer the fact. Leave it for an author-confirmed disclosure/audit.

nonnegotiable_acceptance_invariants: The frozen task population, model revision, source forest, budgets, terminal-state taxonomy, and independent acceptance oracle are held matched across A--D. A later task may version the protocol before final freeze, but may not change these to make an arm pass.

A task is not solved because its queue is empty, its route abstained, its provider hook count is zero, or a candidate says closes_claim. Completion requires current evidence for every mandatory obligation and independent acceptance according to the frozen oracle.

All attempted tasks, including false acceptance, false denial, timeout, abstention, unavailable route, and unsolved outcomes, remain in declared denominators. Missing resource measurements are null with a reason, never zero.
Unsafe disabled-check experiments are isolated with publication disabled. A cold full runner independently scores any claimed reuse.
No entry establishes author identity, consent, model-use history, access permission, a live deployment, or a positive result by implication from source presence, a receipt, or a plan.

evidence_catalog.E-NS001: NS-001 recovered/reconstructed manuscript and source-recovery audit; source recovery does not prove implementation or results.
evidence_catalog.E-NS002-FOREST: NS-002 source_forest, capabilities, and implementation inventory snapshots: source location/import/capability only.
evidence_catalog.E-NS002-PRELIM: NS-002 preliminary_evidence snapshot: checked-in 40-row arithmetic, explicitly not a live model/prover experiment.
evidence_catalog.E-NS004-006: Frozen protocol, leakage-safe population/oracle, and instrumented paired runner from NS-004--NS-006.
evidence_catalog.E-NS007-013: Caller-level qualification receipts for context, provider routing, translation, reuse, sealing/recovery, and one integrated witness from NS-007--NS-013.
evidence_catalog.E-NS014-015: Optional native-proof and procedure/world/refactoring scope decisions or qualification evidence from NS-014--NS-015.
evidence_catalog.E-NS016-020: Frozen final run/ablations and independently scored analysis/Table 17--18 ledger from NS-016--NS-020.
evidence_catalog.E-NS021-025: Reference audit, manuscript reconciliation, author-confirmed disclosure, anonymous release, and final author-review audit from NS-021--NS-025.

claims.claim: A frozen population has a useful-completion rate, net measured cost, uncertainty intervals, and false-admission result.
claims.publication_rule: Replace the placeholder only with generated, independently scored values and denominators; otherwise describe no outcome.

claims.claim: The architecture maintains typed semantic, operational, and durable evidence and specifies routing, checking, sealing, reuse, and evaluation.
claims.publication_rule: Use 'design'/'specified' unless an actual call chain is qualified; source presence alone is insufficient.

claims.claim: Hashes, model confidence, and available solvers do not prove arbitrary Python correct.
claims.publication_rule: Retain as a limitation, not as a universal formal theorem.

claims.claim: Persistent state-and-obligation representation can organize source intent, explicit obligations, proposal routing, evidence reuse, and accepted transitions.
claims.publication_rule: Present as the proposed composition; any claim that it enables incremental work or reduces context must cite qualification or final results.

claims.claim: The prototype has source-present components but incompletely qualified integration paths, and final claims need an exact loaded multi-repository forest.
claims.publication_rule: Keep the qualification distinction and exact forest binding; do not turn it into deployment evidence.

claims.claim: A semantic root represents program facts/contracts/dependencies/limits, not task completion, permission, or all-language correctness.
claims.publication_rule: Retain the non-establishment limitation; qualify the actual producer/consumer.

claims.claim: Operational task state may record decisions but does not change semantic meaning or establish proof correctness.
claims.publication_rule: Retain as an intended authority separation pending caller-level qualification.

claims.claim: Canonical bytes/CAS records do not establish truth, fresh applicability, or authorization merely by persistence.
claims.publication_rule: Retain limitation; actual publication claims require restart/CAS evidence.

claims.claim: The semantic index/producer extracts and seals typed source evidence and supplies selection/freshness without deciding acceptance or running tests.
claims.publication_rule: Name only inspected surfaces until source-linked qualification demonstrates this behavior.

claims.claim: Claims have identity, applicability, checker, environment, policy, and provenance dimensions; integrity/evidence/authorization are distinct.
claims.publication_rule: Keep as typed model and conditional argument, never as a proof of universal equivalence.

claims.claim: Exact fresh dependency capsules can support reuse while stale, opaque, or dynamic dependencies expand validation frontier.
claims.publication_rule: Positive reuse requires cold-oracle agreement and adversarial mutations; otherwise retain only the conservative protocol.

claims.claim: Abstract interpretation, assume-guarantee, SMT/interpolation, proof search, temporal/deontic views, and ZK attestation each have a limited question and stated qualification obligation.
claims.publication_rule: No row licenses a backend or theorem: retain only a tested supported profile; mark unavailable rows out of scope.

claims.claim: Cross-domain IR, manifest-bound authorization, revocation/context checks, and receipt consumption are interfaces with separate correctness/authorization gates; inspected rollout is off/shadow.
claims.publication_rule: Retain off/shadow limitation; deployment language requires actual connected-tool evidence.

claims.claim: Lossy projections cannot establish original temporal/deontic obligations; supported translation and solver outcomes have bounded semantics.
claims.publication_rule: Require modal countermodels, caller admission evidence, and separate solver/reconstruction claims; do not claim retained-clause speedup from assertion replay.

claims.claim: Objective compilation and residual plans are admitted only after schema/dependency/scope/resource/acceptance checks; models cannot lower objectives or remove tests.
claims.publication_rule: Must be demonstrated through the real caller and current authority bindings, including valid progress.

claims.claim: The kernel can defer, deterministically choose, abstain, or authorize a residual, but neither its boolean nor zero local hooks proves workflow success/savings.
claims.publication_rule: Retain negative boundary now; any authorized-provider or savings claim requires real provider-boundary receipts and independent validation.

claims.claim: Event invalidation, PlanDelta retention, bounded refill, and reconciliation preserve mandatory obligations; queue exhaustion is not success.
claims.publication_rule: Keep the queue/nonconvergence limitation; world consumption is optional and requires observed pre/post consumption or removal.

claims.claim: State-bound repair may use dependency/abstract/contract analyses and a fenced patch-validation path; generic tokenizer-alias and CST/AST editing are separate extensions.
claims.publication_rule: Qualify only actual source-linked edit path. Narrow general semantic editing to future work.

claims.claim: Context capsules retain non-truncatable goal/authority/scope/acceptance evidence and bind optional compression/cache reuse to identities.
claims.publication_rule: No savings or sufficiency claim without matched A/B run evidence; required obligations may never be removed to meet a target.

claims.claim: Procedure synthesis, incoming memory, learned candidates, and architecture refactoring are bounded/non-authoritative and require applicability, holdouts, validation, rollback, and consumed evidence.
claims.publication_rule: Default closure is future work with prior learned no-go preserved. Retain no efficacy/equivalence/refactoring benefit claim without the optional campaign's evidence.

claims.claim: Certificates have bounded statements and trust profiles; Groth16 source presence/opt-in wrapper and restricted derivation do not establish test execution, a qualified circuit, ceremony, or timing.
claims.publication_rule: State native profile unavailable/untested unless NS-014 supplies compiled backend, circuit, keys, verifier, attacks, and measured costs.

claims.claim: Membership, signed observation, formal proof, aggregation, and direct execution each establish only their named relation with remaining assumptions.
claims.publication_rule: Retain all limiting columns; never upgrade one evidence class into another.

claims.claim: Fixture/call/teardown reuse needs complete lifecycle identity and a dependency projection; opaque closure or teardown failure forces execution.
claims.publication_rule: Require lifecycle/adversarial mutation receipts plus independent cold full-run scoring before any reuse effectiveness claim.

claims.claim: Complete manifests, parent-bound delta seals, persistence, CAS, and parallel preparation require completeness/recovery checks and do not provide global consensus.
claims.publication_rule: Require sequential/parallel equivalence, fault injection, restart reconciliation, and valid recovery continuation; retain no federation claim.

claims.claim: The acceptance invariant is a conditional design invariant, not proof that current code universally enforces it or exactly-once side effects.
claims.publication_rule: State initial-policy, exact-input, exclusive-publication, and trusted-effect assumptions with mapped gates.

claims.claim: Multi-agent/world roots and required-mode state consumption are an extension requiring transactional authority and observed consumption.
claims.publication_rule: No federation/deployment claim without tested deployment; otherwise future-work-only wording.

claims.claim: A-D matched comparisons, isolated ablations, hidden independent oracles, full terminal denominators, direct resource measurement, and preregistered thresholds are required for an efficacy conclusion.
claims.publication_rule: Protocol claims may remain; all actual values and any promotion decision require frozen analysis. The final-results placeholder cannot remain.

claims.claim: Each context/routing/repair/reuse/sealing comparison pairs safety with useful-progress outcomes; deny-all is not a competitive baseline.
claims.publication_rule: Each row needs matched configuration, independent oracle, and both safety/progress denominators if promoted to a result.

claims.claim: A checked-in 40-task report has 58.90% median estimated context reduction and no model receipts.
claims.publication_rule: Use exactly as repository-reported preliminary arithmetic, not live inference savings, repair accuracy, or dispatch evidence.

claims.claim: A checked-in 40-transition summary reports 43.6161% reuse and 43.0539% estimated compute reduction, with no measured timing/GPU proof.
claims.publication_rule: Use only with all stated limitations; not measured prover speedup or test execution evidence.

claims.claim: Source inspection locates typed-state/routing/formalization/synthesis/storage surfaces but not a fully integrated deployment or runtime qualification.
claims.publication_rule: Keep source-present qualification and limitations.

claims.claim: Loaded forest binding, conditional claims, established-method attribution, protected acceptance authority, independent holdouts, accurate model-use disclosure, and paired evaluation delimit the contribution.
claims.publication_rule: Do not claim first neurosymbolic agent, automatic improvement, self-improvement, author facts, or disclosure facts without direct evidence/author confirmation.

table17_rows.obligation: Immutable per-task receipts under frozen task/oracle/model/budget; report accepted solved/total, false accept/deny, tokens/cost, elapsed/human time with units and full terminal denominators.
Same A controls except prespecified semantic-context intervention; independently score all columns and evidence consumption.
Same matched controls plus caller-level routing/reuse qualification and cold-oracle reference; report package effect, not isolated benefit.
Same matched controls plus persisted/restarted publication evidence; report package effect and recovery outcomes.

table18_rows.obligation: Paired current-binding mismatch rejection and permitted residual progress with independent downstream validation; record actual provider boundary evidence ID.
Paired lossy/unsupported rejection and supported translation progress; bind formula root, solver/checker profile, and evidence ID.
Either positive/negative circuit-key-profile cases with actual backend and measured costs, or mark untested/unavailable/out of scope and remove native-proof performance/deployment text.
Paired dependency/lifecycle mutation rejection and unchanged valid progress, each independently cold-scored; record lifecycle and evidence ID.
Paired stale/corrupt/crash rejection/reconciliation and valid continuation after recovery; record parent/generation/root evidence ID.
Either paired pre-state consumption/accepted post-state evidence on held-out bounded profile, or mark untested/out of scope and remove required-mode extension claim.
